questions.q: A teammate ran forward and cleared the middle. Tap the space the fixo moves into.
options: The middle angle behind the ball
The front lane beside the runner
questions.explain: Yes. The fixo steps into the middle angle, so the left ala has new support.
choiceExplanations: Yes. The fixo steps into the middle angle, so the left ala has new support.
A teammate already filled that forward lane. Two players there crowd the same space.
From deep, the fixo is too far away to help. The middle space stays empty.

questions.q: In 4-0, players share the space. Put these steps in order.
options: Pass out to the left ala
A teammate runs forward, clearing space
Fixo steps into the middle angle
Pass into the fixo's new support
questions.explain: Right. The pass goes wide, a run clears space, the fixo fills it, then we use it.
choiceExplanations: Right. The pass goes wide, a run clears space, the fixo fills it, then we use it.
A teammate runs forward first. That clears the middle space for someone else.
The fixo moves only after the middle is empty. Then the new angle is ready.
We pass to the fixo last, once they stand in the new angle.

questions.q: The right ala has the ball, and a teammate ran forward. Where does the fixo go?
options: Up into the front lane too
Into the middle angle near the ball
Out wide beside the right ala
questions.explain: Yes. The runner left the middle empty, so the fixo fills it and gives the ball a new angle.
choiceExplanations: A teammate is already in that forward lane. Two runners there share one space and help nobody.
Yes. The runner left the middle empty, so the fixo fills it and gives the ball a new angle.
Standing right beside the ball crowds the right ala. One defender can then guard you both.
